page.content:
Genetic homeland of Arabica and the origin story of coffee drinking.

How Ethiopia connects

  • Item: Coffea arabica — Coffea arabica is native to the Ethiopian highlands.
  • Topic: Coffee — Ethiopia is the genetic and legendary origin of Arabica coffee.
  • Location: Yirgacheffe — Yirgacheffe is an Ethiopian origin region for washed arabica.
  • Location: Sidama — Sidama is a southern Ethiopian coffee origin.
  • Character: Kaldi — The Kaldi legend is set among Ethiopian coffee shrubs.

What is Ethiopia?

Ethiopia holds wild Coffea arabica and the Kaldi legend. Regions such as Yirgacheffe and Sidama are still named on specialty bags as origin, not just country.

Key threads lead to Coffea arabica, Coffee, Yirgacheffe, Sidama and Kaldi.
